headline: 欢迎有志于结构生物学和药物研发的优秀人才加入 Wu Lab
headlineEn: We welcome motivated researchers and students interested in structural biology and drug discovery to join the Wu Lab.

positions.title: 助理研究员
requirements: 具有博士研究生学历学位，符合药物所社会公开招聘岗位的基本条件
计算生物学、药物化学、糖生物学、药理学等相关专业背景
具有计算生物学背景者优先
本岗位按药物所公开招聘程序报名、资格审查和考核，具体条件以官方公告及岗位信息表为准
directions: 疾病相关靶点的结构药理学
结构与计算驱动的药物发现
糖生物学与药理机制研究
benefits: 药物所科研岗 / 专业技术岗位
报名截止时间、人员类型、户籍及工作经历要求以官方公告为准
positions.linkLabel: 查看药物所助理研究员招聘公告与报名要求

positions.title: 博士后
positions.titleEn: Postdoctoral Fellow · 计划招收 2 人
requirements: 一般应获得博士学位不超过 3 年，或为即将毕业的应届博士毕业生，进站时年龄一般不超过 35 周岁
计算生物学、药物化学、糖生物学、药理学等相关专业背景
具有计算生物学背景者优先
具有较强的独立科研、英文写作和沟通能力，原则上以第一作者发表过高水平研究论文
须全脱产从事博士后研究工作，并符合国家及院校博士后进站要求
directions: 疾病相关靶点的结构药理学
结构与计算驱动的药物发现
糖生物学与药理机制研究
benefits: 提供具有竞争力的薪酬待遇，具体面议
享受社会保险、住房公积金等政策待遇
支持申请中国医学科学院北京协和医学院优秀博士后专项资助计划

positionsEn.title: Assistant Researcher
requirements: A doctoral degree and eligibility under the Institute of Materia Medica public recruitment requirements
Background in computational biology, medicinal chemistry, glycobiology, pharmacology, or a related discipline
Applicants with a computational biology background are preferred
Applications, eligibility review, and assessment follow the Institute's official public recruitment process; the official announcement and position table govern
benefits: Research / professional technical position at the Institute of Materia Medica
Please consult the official announcement for the deadline, applicant category, residency, and experience requirements
positionsEn.linkLabel: View the official Assistant Researcher recruitment announcement

positionsEn.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
requirements: A Ph.D. normally awarded within the past three years, or expected shortly; applicants are generally expected to be under 35 upon appointment
Background in computational biology, medicinal chemistry, glycobiology, pharmacology, or a related discipline
Applicants with a computational biology background are preferred
Strong independent research, English writing, and communication skills, normally supported by at least one high-level first-author publication
Full-time postdoctoral research and eligibility under national and institutional appointment rules
benefits: Competitive compensation, subject to individual discussion
Social insurance and housing provident fund benefits in accordance with policy
Support for applications to the CAMS & PUMC Excellent Postdoctoral Fellowship Program
positionsEn.linkLabel: View the official postdoctoral recruitment announcement and full requirements

positionsEn.title: Master's Student
requirements: Background in biology, pharmacy, chemistry, or a related discipline
